The ability to carry this puzzle easily makes it great to travel with or take to grandmas as well.This puzzle "At the Zoo" is a fun open interpretation.  It has lots of colors to draw your attention and the pieces are big and easy to handle and put in place.  My three year old had lots of fun putting this together and seemed to be able to manage it mostly with just encouragement from me and not actual help.I would recommend "At the Zoo" or any of Mudpuppy's many great floor puzzles for kids of all ages.
summary: Great stuff for little ones. Trust the mudpuppy.

reviewText: This is a great children's puzzle.  The picture is adorable and will inspire a lot of questions about animals.  The puzzle itself is imprinted on that thick multi-layered, non-corrugated cardboard - the layers may start to peel with much use, but the pieces fit together surprisingly crisply, with an audible snap and no puzzle dust left behind.  The box is bigger than it needs to be to hold the pieces, which is about my only knit pick.

The pictures are fun and engaging.  After the puzzle is together there are lots of counting and identification that can take place.The pieces are large and thick.  So they are easy for little hands to grasp.  Most of the pieces are boarders so putting together is easy.It is cardboard so expect some wear and tear...  however looks like it will wear well.  The biggest danger is to durability is probably a mouth.

My 3 year old daughter LOVES animals, so this puzzle was a hit from the moment I pulled it out of the box.  The actual box it comes in has a nice flap top and it has a rope handle which makes it easy to carry around.  The puzzle itself is shiny cardboard.  The picture has great colors and is very bright. My only complaint is that the pieces didn't fit together easily unless you're on a perfectly flat surface (We tried to put it together on the carpet and we had a hard time getting everything to fit into the each other).  It's a fun puzzle and great for toddlers!
My niece loved this gift which i bought for her for christmas.  Her mom is so exited to build the puzzle with her and I cant wait to see the outcome....

This jumbo puzzle is almost, but not quite, on par with Ravensburger products. I consider it equal to or slightly better when compared to Melissa and Doug products, which are also a high quality producer and probably the closest competitor.  Everything from the box to the puzzle pieces indicate a decent build quality.  The large puzzle pieces are rigid enough and made of quality material but not as thick as Ravensburger.  They do not appear coated like Ravensburger products either; though they have a glossy sheen. However, the manufacturer indicates the product is made with soy based ink, a non-toxic alternative, making it safe for those children that are teething.Usability was engineered for little hands and minds.  These puzzles teach basic problem solving logic and seem to thrill most kids I know, although they never thrilled me as a child. The artwork is relatively simple and should not frustrate children. The box provides a great storage place for the pieces and unlike traditional boxes, it includes a carrying handle.As other reviewers noted, the Ravensburger puzzles can sometimes be bought at a lower cost.  If this is possible, I would choose Ravensburger.  Otherwise, I believe this puzzle is decent quality and targets 2 to 4 year olds.  Older children seem to like Ravensburger given the choice.
summary: Decent, Almost on Par with Ravensburger

reviewText: This puzzle is full of cute animal illustrations, ranging from penguins to elephants to monkeys and peacocks.  The colors really pop to attract young children's eyes.  The large pieces are easy for small hands to put together, or take apart.

This is a very well made little puzzle.  The word 'Jumbo' in the product title refers to the size of the puzzle pieces - not to the size of the puzzle - and the pieces are very well sized for little hands.  The illustration is bright, beautiful, and has lots of great (and funny) little details that my daughter enjoyed finding.As for the pieces, they also seem to be very durable.  They fit together well and seem like they'll take a lot of four-year-old abuse - they can stand up to my daughter's favorite game of dancing on her puzzles after completing them.Her only complaint was the size of the puzzle.  Although the size is clearly noted in the product description, the puzzle is much smaller than the other puzzles we have.All in all, a lovely puzzle that we'll enjoy over and over again.

My 2 1/2 year old daughter absolutely loves this jumbo puzzle.  We received it yesterday, and she played with it for the majority of the evening.  The colors are bright and engaging, and the pieces are made of a seemingly durable cardboard.It is a little difficult to put together on our plush carpeting, but it works great on a hard floor.  The puzzle comes in a sturdy storage box which has a thin rope carry handle.

My kids are 4 and 6 and they just love puzzles, so when that Amazon box arrived my kids jumped with joy!The pieces are big and bright and great for hand and eye coordination. Its enough pieces to make them slow down and think, but not so many that they become overwhelmed and frustrated.Overall it is a great puzzle I highly recommend it!

My three year old son loves this puzzle and has put it together every day for the last week.  It is bright and colorful with cute illustrations of animals at the zoo.  It is age-appropriate for two to four year olds.  I usually help my son put it together by giving him hints on what pieces might work if he gets stuck, but overall it is not difficult for him.  The puzzle has 25 pieces, is a 5 by 5 square, and is fairly large.  The pieces are large, seem durable, and go together easily.  The box is also cute with a carry handle, which allows my son to tote it between rooms and encourages cleaning up after putting it together.  Overall, I have to say this a great puzzle for toddlers and young children.

First, the packaging is fantastic! I love the blue rope handle, allowing my kids (3 and 5) to carry the puzzle  easily without dumping all the pieces. The two other jumbo puzzles we have are in boxes that are much more challenging for the kids to hold and carry. I can't count the number of times they've gotten frustrated before even starting a puzzle because they have to pick up the pieces two or three times first.The pieces are thicker and had a glossier image than I expected. Each piece almost the size of my hand with fingers extended. The pieces fit together perfectly without difficulty for my three-year-old son and five-year-old daughter. My son still needs help with big puzzles, but my daughter can do them without help (and can help her brother).When finished, the finished image is colorful and fun cartoon of the zoo, with a bit of a quirky feel to it.I expect this to hold up for a long time, and - as compared to other brands of jumbo puzzles that we have - this one is a clear winner because the kids can carry it independently with the perfect packaging and handle.
summary: Great puzzle with out of the world packaging, compared to other brands

reviewText: Loved the theme of the puzzle as I can teach my child about real life animals; definitely of educational value. The puzzle's quality is quite strong and seems pretty durable as it is made from a thick cardboard. Wished the puzzle came along with a 'trace-along' folded piece so that it can be easier for a toddler to manage on their own.Overall, a fun, educational and colourful puzzle for any child.

The only reason to not buy this product for your child is if they still haven't quite figured out jigsaw puzzles. This is a classic jigsaw puzzle, the shapes bearing no relationship to the pictures.But if your kid can handle jigsaw puzzles, i highly recommend this one. The pieces are thick and sturdy, the tabs fit securely into the notches without being so snug as to put up a fight. The puzzle, once assembled, is study enough for a cat to walk across without knocking it apart, even on a carpeted floor. The picture is colorful and silly, with animals playing in normal ways (penguins sliding on their bellies) or silly ways (a polar bear cub floating in a red inner tube). Once the puzzle is assembled, you can play name-that-animal, or challenge your child to make up a story about what's going on in the picture. Or you can just take it apart and put it together again.The box is sturdy and designed as a carrying case, so the disassembled puzzle can easily be carried by a child, to a friend's house or preschool or just another room in your house.
Nice puzzle, pretty colors, and the pieces are big enough for a smaller child to play with.  Comes with a handle so it is easy to transport. We had fun putting it together!

When you are three-five years old, puzzles are either too babyish (ie. the shaped board puzzles) or too hard to keep your interest. This puzzle was just right for preschoolers. There are 24 large, sturdy cardboard puzzle pieces in the box to make a 22x22 perfectly squared puzzle. The cute zoo design keeps things rolling as kids enjoy each piece. The first time your preschoolers attempt the puzzle, it will take them a little more time. It can be a little frustrating to learn how to piece something together so I like to turn it into a game of seek and find. As one puzzle piece is discovered, I give hints about the matching piece. I will definitely be hunting down more puzzles like this one to help the kiddos graduate from board puzzles into more challenging kid puzzles. What a great way to stimulate growth in cognitive and motor skills! The only down side I could see is while the puzzle pieces are large (about 3-4") and sturdy, they are made from cardboard and thus can be bent and get creases when children step on them accidentally, or if the puzzle pieces are mishandled/mistreated.
summary: Finally! A Fun and Challenging Puzzle for a Preschooler

reviewText: This is great puzzle for little hands. Colorful pieces and that are easy for young ones to grab and figure out where they go. The animal illustration is very cute (which just a touch of quirk to it) to make it a unique addition to your puzzle library.

We gave this to our 27 month old for Christmas as her first jigsaw puzzle. The box is colorful,durable and easy to carry.  The pieces are the perfect size for her hands. The puzzle has the animals she likes to name. She is too young yet to stay committed to the puzzle, but I have high hopes this will be a favorite in a few more months. Our 5 year old did it easily for her, so I think the right age is probably 3 -4 on this where it is a challenge, but doable.

Got the assortment of Mudpuppy flashcards for my grandson for counting, alphabet, and first words on the recommendation of a mother of four and two-year olds.  The cards are practically indestructible and this is important if you have a child that likes to tear paper (all of his books).  The cards are heavy plastic coated and pictures are brightly colored and attractive to babies.  Quality product.

This jigsaw puzzle has colorful cartoon-like illustrations of animals, ranging from pandas, flamingos, polar bears and monkeys to penguins, turtles, lions, elephants, and peacocks.  There are even several children in the picture.  The colors are striking and it will be fun for kids not only to put this puzzle together, but to identify the assorted animals along the way.Gauged for children 2 years and older, the puzzle contains 25 pieces, which should make it a reasonable challenge for little ones without frustrating them or taxing their concentration span.  It's a fun activity for a cold or rainy day and one that involves motor coordination, visual acuity, and problem solving, so for parents concerned about having their kids learn while they're having fun, this item fills the bill. The puzzle can be enjoyed alone, with a parent, or with a friend.Packaged in a sturdy cardboard box with a cloth handle, the puzzle pieces -- when fully assembled -- measure 22 inches X 22 inches.  For kids, it might also be fun to play a "Where's Waldo" type game in which the child is asked to locate specific animals or objects.  My granddaughter loves locating objects in storybook illustrations, and she was just as focused on finding the toucan, the rabbit, and the girl with the camera in the puzzle picture.
summary: Color, animals, a challenge, and fun!

reviewText: They are attached to a ring and sturdy. I've seen so many brands and this one is the best. Great for my 3year old to learn and get ready for pre-school.
summary: Best flash cards on the market

reviewText: This is a nice colourful puzzle, with a simple design for youngsters 2 years and up - probably to about 4 or 5 years. The 25 pieces are big; each is about 4" x 4". What is good is that the top edge of each puzzle piece is slightly rounded on the edges, which will help keep the picture from peeling away. However the pieces, themselves could be thicker, so that young hands would not be able to bend them so easily.The box is relatively solid and with care will last. Although, the cardboard `catch' to keep it closed starts to show signs of wear after a few uses. The cord is soft and makes it easy to carry the puzzle box.It does seem a bit pricey at this time, for such a simple puzzle.

I bought these when she was about 8 months old, and now at 10 months she will regularly flip through these while she's playing by herself (in addition to me using them with her of course). They are sturdy and will last a long time, even with being chewed on. They'll also be used for a long time, because they have addition and subtraction on some cards, not just pictures and numbers.  The only reason I did not give 5 stars is because the ring will not stay shut, so they go all over, but it's not a big deal.
I have not had problems with the ring yet like the other reviews. My grandson like them and its nice that they stay together instead of being scattered all over.

I bought these for my 2 year old but my 4 year old has swiped them to use to "teach" her dolls.  I love that not only are there numbers and fruits there are also simple addition and subtraction facts as well.  We lay in bed and do some simple facts before she goes to bed.  I'm sure my little guy will love these too when his sister finally gives them back :)
Durable! Great for two and 1/2 year old. Flips easily and doesn't take up much room. Big and good pictures.
My 19 month old likes to bring these in the car.  She will sit and go through them over and over.  The quality is good, easy to hold and cute!

Way better than flimsy cards although they do bend if your kids abuse them. I like the ring so that none of them get lost like with regular flashcards. Some of ours got wet on the table with spills and have bent/deformed but are still usable so I still like them a lot!
summary: Great cards that dont get lost

reviewText: The pictures are bright, colorful and engaging. I love that the cards are on a ring so my son can look at them without them getting all over the floor and we can even take them with us out to dinner.
Purchased these for my 2 year old grandson to help him with learning his ABC's and improve his speach. Fast delivery. Very satisfied.
Not only are these flash cards helpful in helping toddlers learn their ABC's, but they are so well made, they are practically indestructible.

I actually got these for my son for his easter basket this year but i was thinking i would get more for his stocking in the winter. they are reasonably priced and a great quality. who doesnt like nice educational things anyway?
Great learning tool.
Great sturdy cards that all stay together on the ring.  The pictures are clear and the cards are not flimsy.

I love flashcards and kind of have a thing for them, these are great and the ring comes apart so you can use all in a row as well! My 3 1/2 year old likes them, and easy to use while holding a baby in one hand, to just flip over the cards!

These are fabulous cards, and have a sort of mod styling which is cute.  The card themselves are high end - nice glossy treatment to the surface makes them durable to little hands and easy for me to clean up when sticky.  The turn nicely on the plastic ring, however, the ring on this set is looser than the ring on the "colors" set we also bought.  A drop of super glue will solve that for me, since I have no intention of taking them off the ring and later having to hunt them down in the house, but for someone who want sit to stay together and still be able to open them, this may be an issue.  The pictures are pretty clear, in my opinion, and my 4 yr old was able to identify all of the pictures with their letter without issue.  The K for Kangaroo could have been more obvious, but she got it so I guess it wasn't a problem.  My 2.5 yr old identified most of them aside from xylophone (piano), volcano (mountain), and yo-yo.  I didn't really expect her to know those, so I don't think it is a fault with the cards.  Overall I'd buy them again for a gift, but there are more simplistic ABC cards out there for teaching your child the ABCs.  The back side of the cards are perfectly simple though, and I love the bold, clean A on the back of the Apple card, etc.  Those are nice for using to teach!
summary: Great cards - mod styling - good vocab builder too

reviewText: These are really cute and their exactly what I wanted but I do wish they would've used different pictures on some of the letters like For the letter U they put unicorn I wished they would've put something like umbrella other than that their great. one side is just the letter other side is the letter and a picture.
I like the fact they stay together with the sturdy ring, and is perfect for my granddaughter. They are not too expensive.
Great quality. My toddler can't tear this one up for sure. The ring that holds them aren't very secure so you might want to super glue

What I love is that the pictures for each letter are appropriate for a young child and we didn't find any words that were hard to pronounce, learn or even understand. Some children's books and flash cards have really random words chosen, as if they author ran out of ideas for a certain letter. These were a great addition to my 2 year old's Easter basket!
the diary seems nice but the lock broke quite easily for my 8 year old....keys got bent...etc etc. Doa  number lock or soemthing.
I ordered this for my 6 year old as part of his Christmas presents. He loves writing in it and especially loves that he can lock it so his sister can't see what he is writing.

This is an adorable diary/journal.  Just what my 7 year old wanted.  The highlight is that it has a lock on it for all of his secrets!  Plenty of lined pages for this to last him a while.  The quality seems good, although the dimensions are on the small side.
Bought this  cute little diary for my son. He really likes it, and I like that it came with two keys so, I have one I can put up when he loses his.

It is safe & high quality. And the family flips through the cards to reinforce speaking and early reading foundation for my granddaughter - 13 months +  I have seen Elliana choose to flip through the cards without being prompted.  Although we can't quite understand her yet, she points and tries to speak the sounds as she flips the cards.  They know and absorb so much more than most people give them credit for knowing.  NEVER too soon to begin!
summary: Great Addition to Toddler's basket of Learning Tools

reviewText: I bought this for my 6 year old and he loves it. He is able to open the lock. He has carried it with him all over and it is holding up really well! He loves it.
looked and looked for a 'boy' approriate journal for my Tween son, and FINALLY found this onecame with 2 keys, and a pretty good lockhe liked itwould recommend to others
great lillte diary for boys.  bought for my grandsons birthday because his sister hs a diary-  loves iwriting in it
Bought this for my grandson who is 7 1/2,  He wanted a diary with a lock on it.  This was the perfect look for him and it was well made.  It arrived quickly.
Ordered for my 4 year old Grandson because he wanted a book with a lock and I key on it.  Pretty sure he liked it....Did a Little dance of JOY when it arrived.
The only reason that it didn't get 5 stars is for the overall size. Wish it was a little bigger.

My boys wanted journels that they could write in, draw in and lock.  I looked all over in stores and they only had girly ones which would not do!  I got this one for one of my boys.  He liked it a lot especially the robot.  Now he can doodle away and his brother's can't see what he puts in it!!  The lock is a cheap one but I remember the same one being on my diary as a child.  It is fine for now because they are young enough not to realize they can use other things besides keys to open it. LOL
Gave this as a gift and they were very pleased with the construction and design.  I thought the price was far for the product.
Bought this for my daughter for Christmas.  It is everything that was described.  Decent price and a very cute diary.
Size is perfect, and nice amount of pages - lock is substantial enough to make the 'tween in your life feel their secrets are safe.
My boys love this and so do I (mom)Is hard to find things geared towards boys that a mom could also appreciate.The lock works as expected. That was my children's favorite part ages (6,8,10)
my son loved it. I love it because he loves it and because the picture, pieces and box are very nicely made
The box is our best pencil box, big enough to contain pencils, scissor, glue, ruler, eraser, sharpener...The puzzle is a little challenging for 5 years old. however it is fun and of high quality.
Great puzzle for 2 YO! It's perfect for kids who aren't ready for real puzzles, but have out grown their baby puzzles. My daughter loves them!
My 3 year old loves dragons and loves this puzzle!  The pieces are smaller than the others we have, but my son likes it just the same.
This is a wonderful idea for when you need a little quiet play time.  In bed, in church, or special music time.
JUST WHAT I WANTED. DUAGHTER LOVES IT AND IT IS EASY TO USE. THANK YOU AGAIN. IT HAS MANY PICTURES

Love the puzzle, but love the tin even more. My son has a thing for destroying cardboard boxes. These tins are sturdy enough to withstand being stepped all over and dropped and banged about frequently. My son is 3 and they hold his weight well. As far as the puzzle goes, it's not too busy or too sparse and therefore is pretty easy to complete. My son happily sits down with it and completes it on his own without getting frustrated. He loves construction themed items and we had a hard time finding a puzzle that was challenging enough, but still had a picture that would appeal to a younger child. Overall we love this puzzle and the classic car puzzle we bought with it. I hope that they make more designs soon (a fire truck puzzle would be great!) Oh, and the pieces are a shiny hard finish, so they are also easy to clean... say for instance if your cat throws up on them. Gross, but true.

My kids love puzzles and this one is adorable!  The pieces are very high quality and great for little hands.  I like that the pieces don't warp over time - we've done this puzzle many times and it's holding up great!
This is something cute that my 6 year old niece likes to create with. I am thinking of ordering another for my daughter
My kids spent hours coloring and playing with these masks. A great product, easy to assemble and fun patterns that spark creativity.

Love love love these masks.  Great for party activities.  My only complaint is that you have to cut out the top portion to give the mask its shape. Other than that super happy with them.  I look forward to getting the other themes for my parties to come.
summary: Great idea that delivers a great experience.

reviewText: I ordered these for my son's superhero party so that the kids could make masks as a party activity.  They were a big hit and we sent the extras to preschool with him and they were an equally big hit there.  Just a word of caution- the masks come on a pad that is square at the top, so you need to cut each mask out to get the shape pictured...this wasn't a big deal and was glad I opened the package up before the party so I had time to do it the night before.
summary: Great masks- kids loved them!  Make sure you cut them out ahead of time, though!

reviewText: I bought this as a side gift for one of my nieces at Christmas. After opening all their gifts, this was the one they all took to a table and started coloring. My main gift for her sat untouched by the tree.
summary: My nieces and nephew tore into this.

reviewText: These are cute, but they were a little large for the mostly 4 year olds at the party.

Bought this for my 4 year old's superhero bday party.  A big hit!  4 styles of masks to pick from.  They're all bound together, just rip out the styles and number you need.  Kids color, then you cut out around the top of the mask.  And attach yellow bands that it comes with.  Great activity, even the adults colored them.
I bought several masks for my sons super hero party and these were the best. The kids loved choosing and coloring their own.

These were a huge hit at my son's Kindergarten class. All the kids had a blast picking out their masks. It comes with string. Easy to work with. Very stiff quality paper so that they maintain their shape and are still flexible. Glad I purchased.

a fun activity for kids!  you will have to cut out each individual mask from the book and attach the elastic yourself before giving the masks to kids, so there is some prep time that is needed.  these are great for the age 2-6 group.  both little girls and boys will enjoy coloring them.  20 masks included.

Purchased these for my daughter's 5th birthday along with crayons and jewel stickers. We had about 35 kids of different ages (girls and boys). I was shocked at how they all obsessed over decorating and then wearing them. One thing to note is that they do require 30 mins of set up work (for whole pack) before a party. Very very pleased despite the cutting out
The only Negative, if i had to have one,  is the masks were not perforated so a bit of a pain to cut out.
summary: A HUGE hit at my 7 year olds Birthday Party

reviewText: My girls love it - ages 5 and 2.5! It keeps them entertained for nice chunks if time and is really excellent quality.

My son is 3 years old and loves this puzzle.  He can put it together on his own, but it's challenging enough to keep him occupied.  The picture is really cute, and the pieces are very well made.  I love this brand because the puzzle pieces can be stored in the pouch for very compact storage.  However, the sellers just stuck the shipping label right on the pouch, so now it's too gunky and dirty to use.  I'm going to try to scrub it off, but it wouldn't have been necessary if they'd just put it in an envelope before shipping.

I bought this as a stocking stuffer last Christmas as my girls had mastered their wooden puzzles with the shapes that all fit into their respective holes. This was the perfect transition. They loved it and mastered it in no time. Now on to the bigger ones! P.S. We LOVE the huge Janod floor puzzles now. The pieces are very large and the colors and illustrations are incredible.

Very good transition puzzle from the single piece wood type to jigsaw style. Good for a puzzle loving 2 year old. Probably too simple for many late 3 year olds.  Large pieces that are finished on the back. One side has robots and the reverse shows the color wheel.
My toddler loves these puzzles!  This one has a lot of great animals for him to point out and it's colorful.
Wonderful puzzle for my two year old twins.  They are able to put it together with minimal assistance.  The pouch is nice for storage and keeping all the pieces together.  I would buy more like this.
the picture is pretty busy so it's harder to do for a child, but my 2.5 year old does like it anyway
summary: hard to do, but daughter loves it

reviewText: My son received this for a gift when he was about 26 months old. He'd never done a jigsaw puzzle before, but he loves vehicles. Much to my surprise, he instantly took to the puzzle! It held his attention and right away he was able to put it together with very little adult assistance. Now that he's familiar with the puzzle, he still loves putting it together and talks about which pieces go with which while he does it ("Where's bunny's ears?" "Where's the mixer truck?" etc.). We love this puzzle. The pieces are sturdy and easy to manipulate, the images are cute, and the pouch is convenient. I'm amazed how well this puzzle holds his focus, and any toy I can say that about for a toddler is a winner!
My kiddo loved these stickers!  Arrived on time and a good variety of stickers.  Peeling them off was easy enough for him too.

I bought this for a 5 year old's birthday.  He loved it and played with the stickers for hours and made up stories about the scenes he created with the stickers.  It is not an album, you will have to take the stickers out and use a piece of paper.  Would make a nice little gift or stocking stuffer.
the no. of stickers are less than what i expected. i will not recommend it to my friends, disappointed ><~
summary: will not purchase this item again

reviewText: Fun stickers that my two year old loves!  The trucks are adorable and make for great reward stickers. Great for the price.
This was a great party activity for my 3 year old's birthday! We had the kids put these stickers on their cups
summary: Was great for my 3 year old's birthday!

reviewText: These are great stickers for older toddlers who are into construction vehicles.  However, there are only 2-3 good-size construction vehicle stickers per page and the rest are tiny stickers, like construction cones, signs, etc. Note: These are actual stickers, NOT the re-usable kind that you can decorate pages with, remove and use again. This is not a "sticker book", just a small book of sticker sheets.  Not really worth the price in my opinion, although my toddler loves them and they were under $10.
summary: Very Small, Only 2-3 Good Size Stickers Per Page

reviewText: The ethnic diversity of the dancers in this book made my niece very happy. She kept saying that looking at the ballerinas in the book makes her feel like she's looking at her ballet class.
summary: My seven year old niece loved it!

reviewText: I ordered these for my sons birthday, they were a huge hit! The robots are very sturdy and well made. The kids loved them!

The sweet four year old mermaid in training in our life loved this crown collection.  Her parents plan on taking them along to restaurants for her to color in.  I thought it was the perfect party activity/favor.
summary: Perfect gift for a budding mermaid!

reviewText: I bought these masks for a robot themed birthday party. They were just okay visually, and none of the kids wanted to color one. I should've passed on this one. Maybe they would be better for a child who really loves robots and detailed coloring projects.
These were better than expected.  Great quality, great color. So cute indeed. Size is perfect, and they keep my little 17 month olds attention.  She has really been learning from them. Love them.

This is a good product and just what I wanted for my 1-year-old who is interested in magnets. They are recommended for ages 3+, and I think I should have followed that guideline. He still puts everything in his mouth and chewed a few letters. When he chewed them, little shreds of magnet and wood made it into his mouth (of course). When he's older, these will be perfect.
summary: Good magnets, but I should have followed the age guidelines.

reviewText: Great magnets for my 13 month old who likes to chew. They withstand her handling and she is able to hold them easily and put them back on the fridge.
summary: Great magnets for my 13 month old who likes to ...

reviewText: recommend to all young parents,well manufactured.bright colors to attract child.  Can be stored in box. Child can readily access the letters.

I wanted to get something special for my Robert. He is all over the place with boundless energy. One of the best ways to calm him is to give him something to keep his mind working.There is no better way to quiet down his body than to hand him stickers and a sticker book. It is like a chalk board and chalk but with that there are too many endless possibilities.Not with stickers and matching books!.Kids love stickers. You can't go wrong with stickers.My Robert sat in the same chair for 30 minutes trying to figure out where to stick the red trick or the blue one in his sticker book!Stickers are cheap, they are fun and require no electricity or game board.
summary: Ohhh, stickers! What kid doesn't like them!

reviewText: A beautiful magnet set.  Magnets are a nice thickness and great to re-create Eric Carle stories, group/sort, or just interact with animal names/sounds.  The colourful magnets are a hit with our 19 month old and I'm sure will entertain for years to come.
Bought for 3 year old grandson who is huge hungry caterpillar fan. Clips on container a great idea too. Would recommend.

I just redid our playroom and Eric Carle figures predominately in our decorations and activities.  These magnets are adorable.  They are fantastic on their own, but even better if your children are fans of his books as they can make connections between the magnets and the books.  Some are pretty small, so I would keep an eye on those under 3 just to be safe.
This set arrived right on time and in great condition.  The pieces are a perfect size and very colorful. Perfect for the age group.
summary: Erice Carle Shapes Wood Magnetic Sets - LOVE :)

reviewText: I love these and so do my daughter. Brown bear brown bear is her fav book. However she does chew on them and the paper comes off. So ... I guess they will be saved for later. I'm editing this to say outright that they say that this magnet is for 3+ years. I'm in no way being negative. They know their product and they are right. Definitely not for 3 and under.
summary: Beautiful and fun but not for under 3

reviewText: These magnets are great, but the description says there are 40 pieces and the package only contains 35.In my opinion, they should have included the teacher and children to complete Brown Bear, Brown Bear, another section of food and the cocoon to complete The Very Hungry Caterpillar, and a zebra and boa constrictor to complete Polar Bear, Polar Bear.
summary: Set could be better  - Only 35 pieces not 40

reviewText: When planning for a road trip this summer, I decided to make themed activity bags for my 5 year old son.  I was looking for travel-friendly activities that would be easy to pack, and these robot finger puppets exceeded my expectations.  They were much thicker and sturdier than I was expecting, and large enough for small hands to easily manipulate without being bulky.  By just asking him a few questions about the robots (How do you think this robot feels?  What is he thinking?  Which robots are best friends?  What are they doing today?  Where are the robots going on their trip? etc.), he started acting out stories with the finger puppets.  They held up for the entire trip, and popped out from time to time to do shows for us. I'm sure they won't last forever, but they did much better than I was expecting. We've added these to our travel toy stash, but I could also see these being a great party favor or other small gift.I love Mudpuppy, and once again, I'm thrilled with their product!
summary: Sturdier than expected, and great for travel!

reviewText: Love these! My 2 year old does too. Great thick wood and magnet, had them for a few months now and they are still going strong!
These are great magnets and hold up.  Only wish would be that they are a little larger.  They can easily get swept under the refrigerator.
What a great classic toy.  We also have the letter ones like this.  My daughter loves to play with them and won't ever tire from them.  Would definitely recommend!
Students have enjoyed using these magnets to help retell several Eric Carle books.  Also the magnets great for sorting activities.

WE bought these for a huge magnet board which my wife built for our 2-year-old daughter. Our little one loves the Very Hungry Caterpillar and other Carle books, so she loves these. They seem well-built and the cardboard box with snaps on the top is also durable and very handy for storage. Would buy again.

As you can see on my title the capital "i" looks like a lower case "L"  That is exactly how the letter looks in the box and this will be confusing later on since the capital "i" that is taught in schools doesn't look like a lower case "L".  Other than that letter they are strong, magnetic and my daughter loves them. You get some extra of some letters.
summary: Love all but the upper case "i"

reviewText: I have really enjoyed reading Eric Carle with my 15 month old, and finding out he wrote more than The Very HUngry Caterpillar.When I saw these I just had to get them, more for me than my daughter!Lovely designs, and full back magnet - not small attachments that can fall out.  Layered paper/wood cut outs.  Safe non - toxic vegetable based inks.My daughter has not chewed them but I guess they would sustain some damage if you had a chewy child.
My grandchild loved this. She was soon spelling out words on the refrigerator. Sturdy, attractive, with good, strong, well-attached magnets.

My son has recently been facinated with magnets, so we purchased this for his 1st birthday.  We have placed them on our fridge for him to play with while we're in the kitchen or out on the back porch.  I was a little shocked by the size of the magnets - I anticapted they would be bigger than they are.  I had to move a few higher up on the frigde so he can't get to them because I think they are just too small for a 1 year old to play with.  The larger magnets (they are all different sizes depending on the type of animal) are better sizes.  The box they come in is nice and could probably be used to store the magents or something else.  The magents themselves are wonderful, as they represent a ton of animals in the colorful Eric Carle signature way.
summary: Nice magnets, some a little small

reviewText: These are great!  My 1-year-old loves the fun colors!  We only look at point to them at this stage in the game.  They are definitely too small for younger children.  I agree with the age recommendation.So far, they are very durable and look great on the fridge.

These letters are absolutely adorable and I much prefer them gracing the front of my fridge over the standard plastic ones. They have pretty colors and patterns and the magnet covers the entire back side of the letters. However, I didn't really think about the fact that, due to being lowercase, they'd have dots for the "i"s and "j"s. The dots are not attached to the letters and are itty bitty (1/3" x 1/3"). I imagine they'll be lost very quickly, and I'm kind of disappointed about that. Overall, though, the fact that these are wooden and ridiculously cute outweighs the fact that our "i"s and "j"s will soon (inevitably) be dotless.
summary: Adorable letters with very tiny pieces

reviewText: My litlle one is just at an age where they are trying to pull everything off the fridge, so I thought they might like this magnent set. PROS: Magnents are super cute. They are very sturdy. The magnent backing is strong enough to stay in place through trips to the fridge, but not so strong my baby can't manipulate them freely. CONS: Half the peices are very small. My baby still puts everything in thier mouth, so I had to pull out the bigger animal pieces and put the smaller ones up. I can' t fault the company though, they cleary say it is for ages three and up. So as our little one gets older we'll just add a few here and there until they can play with them all.

These are super cute stencils.  Bought for my girls - 3 and 6 years old and both of them love them.  There are flowers, butterflies, gardening tools, etc.  Very cute designs.  The stencils are made out of really thick cardboard and so far have held up just fine.
These are adorable and well made. Fun  animals that any child will love. Hold very well on any magnetic surface.
I think our grandson will like it.  It is a novel idea and I hope the company will have more catagories in the future.
This is a gift, and looks awesome. I think any child that had an interest in drawing. It will show HOW to mirror an image to build grey matter in the kidd-o's.
we love mudpuppy, the puzzles are such great quality, and i enjoy them as much as my kids do. plan  on buying more soon

As always, so so happy with Mudpuppy Puzzles. I like this size since the pieces are still big enough for my 3.5 year old to work alone, but there are more pieces so he is challenged longer. I bought this puzzle for my son, it was the only 42 piece Mudpuppy available at the time, but I was pleasantly surprised to find it was not totally girly like the picture of the box would have you believe ( not that my son would have cared). Yes, it is a puzzle featuring a girl at a tea party, but the array of animals and cakes in the picture are so colorful and varied, they steal the show- and create a festive and joyful vibe to the puzzle overall.Mudpuppy puzzles are colorful, have sturdy pieces that fit and stay together while small and sometimes uncoordinated hands try to fit the puzzle together (and try and try again to fit the pieces in). The boxes are durable and attractive to store and carry the puzzles. We have many different puzzles at our house, but the Mudpuppy puzzles are the ones my son picks up and plays with over and over and over again (without fussing that the pieces wont stay together).
summary: Such a fan of Mudpuppy Puzzles

reviewText: My 5 yr old son loves puzzles and I was happy to find one that came in a nice tin box vs a card box. The pictures are nice and vibrant , the puzzle pieces are sturdy and the 100 pcs is the perfect challenge for him right now. I got him two so far and plan to get him more.

Got this puzzle for my 4 year old daughter.  She loves it.  The puzzle is made with nice thick cardboard that is sturdy and can take a beating.  The pieces fit together well, very satisfying.  Also the picture is very nice, with good colors and detail - no boring stretches of same colored pieces.
My granddaughter loves all things Babar.  Hard to find things other than books and stuffed animals in the U.S. so I jumped all over this when I saw it quite by accident.

I bought this for my 22 month old grandson for an airplane trip.  He loves the book and  loved the magnets.  We put them away untul the trip but know he will love them since he did when he first opened the tin.  He is a little young for "scenes" but I feel he will grow into it more in a few months.  My daughter and I loved the storage tin, it was well made and will store the magnets.I recommend it to any child who loves the book!

A really fun idea for those who love the book! I was a little disappointed in the size of this product. The scenes from the book and the size of the magnets don't allow for much imaginative play. The magnets are very flimsy, too. My son has barely shown any interest in it. I'm hoping that will change bc I think it's cool!

My 4 year old loves this magnet set! He loves that the magnets look like the characters in his book (Goodnight Construction Site).  I didn't notice any weird smell like one of the reviews mentioned. This is the perfect gift for a little boy!

My son is a major fan of goodnight goodnight construction site. And this toy has all of the characters. But what it doesn't have is a lot of space use the magnets; they all end up on top of each other. I thought it could be a good car toy, but there's no way for a 3 year old to handle the large amount of magnet since they all can't be in the scene at the same time. The product is cute, but I wouldn't purchase it again.
My son loves his magnets and matches them up to the book every time we read it. I would have given it five stars but the tin is flimsy.

What can you say, it's an amazing story so what better way for your kids to interact with the characters than with this magnetic set. My 2 year old boy absolutely loves it so when he opened this up Christmas morning, he had it opened in no time and playing around with it. So that's the why with this purchase.As another review has mentioned, the magnets are thin, but I honestly don't know what they were expecting. It's no different than the magnet you get from a dentist with their number on it or anything similar. They are relatively strong, strong enough to hold the different scenes up on the fridge. Speaking of scenes, as in the description there are 4 of them. They are on the flip side of two pieces of paper stock with a highly glossed surface. They've got some stiffness to them, but still can be bent/creased, so beware if your little one has a knack for that.I've added 2 customer submitted photos. One just shows the scene card along with all the magnets and the second one shows some magnets "set" in a scene. One really cool thing about this is that the tin container is magnetic so it can be taken with you on the go for the kids to play along with whether it's in the car or at grandma and grandpa's house.Summary: For the price it's a good value. reviewText: I won't waste my time going into reviewing the interface quality for a program at this price point; let's just say there is more to be desired.  What I am writing about today is about the quality of customer service you can expect from this company.  They tout themselves as Christians but are more like thieves.  Whenever you purchase software you are in essence licensing the software itself not the media on which it is printed.  I had just purchased this product and had accidently scratched the CD shortly after opening it (accidents happen).  I called the company and was able to produce the receipt proving that I had just purchased their product, I also told them the truth about what had happened (I wish I would have lied at this point).  I was told that they had to charge me almost the full price of the CD to replace it!  I was shocked!!!!  I told them that I purchased the content on the CD and not the CD itself and that I did not mind paying a processing fee for a new one but that cost should be minimal.  They forwarded my call to a manager who ended up calling me a day later to tell me that they would have to charge the full replacement price for the CD.  I told them that this was the last year my child would be using their product and I would let everyone else know what kind of service they offer.  I do not recommend doing business with a company whose only goal is scrape every penny from your bank account.  Christians?  Yea Right!!!
summary: Any they call themselves Christians... more like thieves...

reviewText: The idea of a program completely on the computer was appealing to me as a first time home-schooling mom.  I bought this curriculum (2008 version) for both my 7th and 8th graders.  We all found the program very constrictive and quite honestly, just plain irritating!  We struggled with having the right concept, sometime even answering with synonyms and the computer still telling us the answer was wrong.  In a few cases more than one word is acceptable but if you are not on track with their line of thinking - you can be close but not close enough.  I would have to use the parent password to figure out what EXACT answer was needed.  I do mean EXACT - spelling, plural/non-plural, no synonyms, spell the number or numeric...I agree that in certain subjects spelling should be correct but sometimes learning a new concept you just need to get the concept and grasp the spelling later - even partial credit would be nice -but not with SOS. There was way more hands on involvement than I expected - I would have rather used paper/pencil workbooks like by 2nd and 3rd graders used.  After paying 600 dollars for both grades we struggled through but I definitely will not buy this curriculum again.
